CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Desktop top navigation opens and routes correctly for major categories
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On NAP and MRP desktop, hover/click top-level categories and verify the expected first-level routing and flyout behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Top-level categories open consistently on desktop.
Category links route to the expected listing pages.
No blocked or dead-end navigation state appears.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Mobile hamburger navigation exposes nested menu and closes/returns reliably
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On mobile web for NAP and MRP, open hamburger menu, drill into nested levels, and navigate back/close repeatedly.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Menu opens and closes without visual breakage.
Nested levels are reachable and reversible.
Scroll and tap interactions remain stable during navigation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: All configured flyout template variants render correctly
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Validate no-flyout, text+image, and multi-column variants where configured in desktop and mobile contexts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Configured template variant matches expected layout.
No fallback-to-wrong-template behavior is observed.
Content blocks render without overlap or clipping.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Product carousel and product-list style modules show valid data and interactions
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open navigation entries with product carousel/list content and verify item load, image rendering, and click-through behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Product data is populated with valid items.
Item click-through opens the correct product page.
Carousel/list visuals align with active brand styling.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Trending designers module is visible and navigable where configured
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Verify the trending designers section appears in configured meganav nodes and links resolve as intended.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Module is rendered in configured positions.
Designer links are clickable and route correctly.
Module styling remains consistent across brands.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Navigation supports no-flyout categories without empty overlays
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open categories configured as no-flyout and confirm no blank flyout panel appears.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No-flyout items route directly without showing empty panels.
Header state remains stable after repeated navigation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: UX feedback fixes for spacing, typography, and card layout are reflected in navigation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Review corrected areas from UX feedback tickets, including title spacing, card spacing, and header/navigation visual details.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Agreed spacing and typography adjustments are visible.
Marketing cards and navigation titles match intended presentation.
No major regressions appear in corrected areas.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Brand-specific style exceptions are preserved between NAP and MRP
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Compare the same meganav structures in NAP and MRP and confirm expected visual deltas are present while behavior remains equivalent.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Brand-specific visual differences appear only where intended.
Functional navigation behavior remains equivalent across brands.
No cross-brand asset leakage is visible.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Mobile login/register entry point is present and routes correctly for guests
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On mobile web, verify guest users can access login/register from navigation and return to browsing state after navigation.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Login/Register entry is visible for guests.
Tap action routes to authentication flow correctly.
Returning from auth does not break menu state.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer service links are available and correctly mapped in mobile navigation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open account/service area from mobile menu and validate customer service link presence, labels, and destinations.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All expected service links are present.
Each link routes to the intended destination.
Spacing and hover/active states are acceptable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Meganav changes do not regress core browse journey from homepage to PLP/PDP
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Execute a short browse journey for both brands from homepage through category to product page using meganav entry points.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Journey completes without broken navigation transitions.
No severe UI regressions block browsing.
Core pages remain reachable from updated meganav.
